name: Replay Attack
Description: An attack where legitimate control commands or telemetry packets are intercepted from the wireless communication link and re-transmitted at a later time by an unauthorized sender.
Symptoms: Repeated packet sequence numbers detected in control or telemetry streams
Out-of-order execution warnings in flight controller logs
Lag, delayed responsiveness, or stuttering movements in response to operator inputs
Impact: Allows unauthorized commands to be executed, potentially overriding operator controls, executing stale configurations, or causing sudden flight path instability.
Recommended Action: Invalidate the current session tokens. Discard commands that contain stale timestamps or out-of-order packet counters. Enforce cryptographic challenge-response mechanisms on the communication channel.
